content:
LAREDO — Brian Rodriguez was arrested on October 25, 2026, at 7:09 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged felony drug charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

The booking record lists possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 2 under one gram, a state jail felony. Bond had not been set.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
